description:
## Context
Issue #814: `plugins/adlc-copilot/package.json:36` defines `"test": "node --test test/*.test.mjs hooks/test/*.test.mjs"`, omitting `lib/test/*.test.mjs` and `mcp/test/*.test.mjs` that `scripts/run-tests.mjs` runs in CI. Running `npm test` inside `plugins/adlc-copilot` skips the prosecutor delegation and MCP stdio protocol suites.

## Normative Decisions
1. Update `scripts.test` in `plugins/adlc-copilot/package.json` to `"node --test test/*.test.mjs hooks/test/*.test.mjs lib/test/*.test.mjs mcp/test/*.test.mjs"`.
2. Add a contract test in `plugins/adlc-copilot/test/contract.test.mjs` verifying that `package.json` `scripts.test` includes all four test suite globs (`test/*.test.mjs`, `hooks/test/*.test.mjs`, `lib/test/*.test.mjs`, `mcp/test/*.test.mjs`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: `plugins/adlc-copilot/package.json` `scripts.test` includes `lib/test/*.test.mjs` and `mcp/test/*.test.mjs` (`verify: node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/test/contract.test.mjs`).
- AC2: All four test globs pass when executed via the package test command (`verify: node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/test/*.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/*.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/lib/test/*.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/mcp/test/*.test.mjs`).
title: plugin(adlc-copilot): include lib/test and mcp/test in package npm test script (#814)
